hints.title: Strictly Greater Predecessor
hints.text: To satisfy strict increase, each element nums[i] must be at least nums[i - 1] + 1.

hints.title: Greedy Minimum Increment
hints.text: If nums[i] <= nums[i - 1], increment nums[i] to exactly nums[i - 1] + 1 to minimize future adjustments.

hints.title: Accumulate Differences
hints.text: Add the increment count to the total operations and update the current element.

hints.title: Full Implementation

complexity.whyNaiveFails: Incrementing elements one unit at a time takes O(sum of diffs) which is needlessly slow.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: A single linear pass computing difference arithmetic runs in O(n) time and O(1) space.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Candidate updates nums[i] directly or tracks previous target in constant space.

solutions.approach: Greedy linear pass with target increment
